questions.question: Who played Albus Dumbledore from Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban onward?
questions.note: Harris played him in the first two films and died in 2002. Hurt is Ollivander.

questions.question: Who played Davy Jones in the Pirates of the Caribbean films?
questions.note: The tentacled captain of the Flying Dutchman. Rush is Barbossa; Bardem is Salazar.

questions.question: Who played the liquid-metal T-1000 in Terminator 2: Judgment Day?
questions.note: Arnold is the T-800 this time. Biehn was Kyle Reese in the 1984 original; Englund is Freddy Krueger.

questions.question: Who played Gollum, via motion capture, in The Lord of the Rings films?
questions.note: Serkis later used the same technique for King Kong, Caesar in Planet of the Apes, and Snoke.

questions.question: Who played Commissioner Gordon in Christopher Nolan’s Dark Knight trilogy?
questions.note: Freeman is Lucius Fox; Caine is Alfred.

questions.question: Who played Harry, the talkative Wet Bandit, in Home Alone?
questions.note: Stern is Marv. Heard plays Kevin’s dad, Peter McCallister.

questions.question: Who played Rubeus Hagrid in the Harry Potter films?
questions.note: Gleeson is Mad-Eye Moody; Isaacs is Lucius Malfoy. Harris was the first Dumbledore.

questions.question: Who played Morpheus in The Matrix?
questions.note: A classic mix-up with Jackson, who later played Nick Fury for Marvel.

questions.question: Who played Saruman in The Lord of the Rings films?
questions.note: McKellen is Gandalf. Hill is Théoden. Lee was also Count Dooku in the Star Wars prequels.

questions.question: Who played Andy Sachs, the assistant, in The Devil Wears Prada?
questions.note: Blunt is Emily, the first assistant. Streep is Miranda Priestly.
